scripts.build: npm run build -w @shopmaple/api && npm run build -w @shopmaple/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:deploy
scripts.test:deploy: tsx --test deploy/public-preview.test.ts deploy/bootstrap-shop-admin.test.ts && node --test deploy/media-backup.test.mjs && node --env-file=.env --test deploy/paired-backup.test.mjs deploy/backup-module-import.test.mjs
scripts.test:deploy:db: tsx --env-file=.env --test deploy/public-preview.db.test.ts deploy/bootstrap-shop-admin.db.test.ts && node --env-file=.env --import tsx --test deploy/paired-recovery.db.test.mjs
scripts.security:static: semgrep scan --config p/javascript --config p/typescript --config p/nodejs --metrics=off --disable-version-check --error --strict apps packages scripts deploy
scripts.security:check: npm run security:dependencies && npm run security:secrets && npm run security:static
